summary: Compiler and engine that runs large language models natively on almost any GPU, phone or browser, with an OpenAI-compatible API.

heroCommands.command: Follow the install guide at llm.mlc.ai/docs

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: MLC LLM is a machine learning compiler and high-performance deployment engine for large language models. It compiles models to run on MLCEngine, one inference engine that works across AMD, NVIDIA, Apple and Intel GPUs (via Vulkan, CUDA, ROCm or Metal), in web browsers (WebGPU and WASM), on iPhones and iPads (Metal) and on Android (OpenCL on Adreno and Mali GPUs). MLCEngine exposes an OpenAI-compatible API through a REST server, Python, JavaScript, iOS and Android.
sixtySeconds.problem: Each device and GPU vendor usually needs its own LLM runtime. MLC LLM compiles models once to run natively across all of them.
whoFor: Developers deploying LLMs on phones or in browsers
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Pick it when you need the same LLM app to run on many kinds of hardware, including mobile and web.
requirements: See the official installation guide for your platform
